_comment: FW-127 acquisition report - the 0x602F schema 1 payload, defined ONCE.
Derived from the serializer's own offsets in src/CAN_Display.c
(fw127_serialize_report). Positions are NEVER inferred from the values in a captured
payload - that is exactly how a decoder ends up confidently reporting the wrong field.
ORPHANS ARE NOT ERRORS. current_sample_ctx_consume() runs at the top of every ADC ISR,
but a transaction is only published when FOC actually runs. Every ISR with the bridge
live and FOC not running - the FW-117 neutral dwell, the calibration hold, and the
soft-cutoff window - therefore consumes without a publish and counts as an orphan.
That is expected. This counter cannot by itself distinguish that benign case from a
genuinely missed publish while FOC was running; invalid_count and starved_count are what

fields.name: schema
fields.note: layout version

fields.name: flags
fields.note: bit0 = context snapshot coherent, bit1 = no illegal CH3 was ever programmed

fields.name: clamp_total
fields.note: PWM periods in which ANY phase had to be clamped

fields.name: clamp_phase_A
fields.note: per-phase clamp hits

fields.name: clamp_phase_B
fields.note: per-phase clamp hits

fields.name: clamp_phase_C
fields.note: per-phase clamp hits

fields.name: peak_requested
fields.note: highest compare SVPWM ever asked for (may exceed ARR)

fields.name: min_requested
fields.note: lowest compare SVPWM ever asked for (may be negative)

fields.name: peak_applied
fields.note: highest compare actually written to TIMER0

fields.name: min_applied
fields.note: lowest compare actually written to TIMER0

fields.name: primary_count
fields.note: samples with all three shunts conducting through the aperture

fields.name: alternate_count
fields.note: samples where one phase was rebuilt by 2-of-3

fields.name: invalid_count
fields.note: samples with no trustworthy sampling window

fields.name: reuse_count
fields.note: INVALID samples served from last-valid

fields.name: max_sample_age
fields.note: longest run of consecutive INVALID samples

fields.name: starved_count
fields.note: INVALID with no last-valid available at all

fields.name: age_bucket_1
fields.note: sample_age == 1

fields.name: age_bucket_2_3
fields.note: sample_age 2..3

fields.name: age_bucket_4_7
fields.note: sample_age 4..7

fields.name: age_bucket_8up
fields.note: sample_age >= 8

fields.name: orphan_count
fields.note: consumes that found no published context waiting
